in_marathi.name: Sheetal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Cool, Calm, Serene
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sheetal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bringing the essence of coolness, calmness and serenity. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'sheet' meaning cool and 'ala' meaning wave, this name is often given to children born during spring time.
